ben_support: Hey team — customer (Acme) reports that rerank endpoint is returning unexpectedly high scores for unrelated docs after they switched embedding provider. No 400/500s, just weird ranking. Repro steps and payload below.

ben_support: ```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "How do I reset my password?",
  "query_embedding": { "dims": 1536, "vector": [0.01, 0.02, ...] },
  "candidate_embeddings": [ { "dims": 1536, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, ...], "id": "doc_1" }, { "dims": 1536, "vector": [0.3, 0.4, ...], "id": "doc_unrelated" } ]
}
```

ben_support: When we compare scores, doc_unrelated scores above doc_1. They swapped embed model from "redwood-embed-1024" -> a third-party 1536-dim model.

alice.dev: Thanks. Do you have the full response body (status + body)? Any x-request-id or timing info?

ben_support: Customer sent response body: 

ben_support: ```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "results": [ { "id": "doc_unrelated", "score": 0.92 }, { "id": "doc_1", "score": 0.31 } ]
}
```

carlos_ml: This smells like an embedding dimension/variant handling bug. Reranker code path currently does a best-effort align of vector sizes for some model families which can silently truncate or pad when dims mismatch. If query is 1536 and our reranker expects 1024, the alignment can produce nonsense similarity.

carlos_ml: Immediate workarounds:
- Recompute embeddings with a 1024-dim model (redwood-embed-1024)
- Use our embed conversion endpoint to down-proj with PCA: `POST /v1/embeds/convert` with `target_dim=1024`
- Or call rerank with precomputed same-dim vectors via `vectors` field instead of sending model ids

alice.dev: Can you include a minimal curl for customers?

carlos_ml: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query_embedding": {"dims":1024, "vector": [...]}, "candidate_embeddings": [...] }'
```

ops-ryan: I'll book a quick on-call patch. Plan: 1) add strict dim validation in rerank handler to return 400 with explanatory message; 2) short-term add compatibility warning header; 3) longer-term add model-pairing enforcement in gateway. ETA for hotfix: ~4h.

support-bot: Incident INC-4921 created (rerank-dim-mismatch). Assigned: ops-ryan.

ben_support: Sent customer the immediate steps + conversion option. They've asked for repro script so attaching a tiny sample dataset.

ben_support: ```json
[ { "id": "q1", "query_embedding": { "dims":1536, "vector": [0.01,0.02,...] }, "candidates": [ {"id":"doc_1","dims":1536,"vector":[0.1,0.2,...]}, {"id":"doc_unrelated","dims":1536,"vector":[0.3,0.4,...]} ] } ]
```

alice.dev: Good. Carlos, can you draft the 400 error message text? Something like: "Embedding dimension mismatch: query dims (1536) != candidate dims (1024). Recompute embeddings with matching model or use embeds/convert."

carlos_ml: Yep. Also logging note: include `embed_model` metadata when present. Current customer used third-party provider so metadata was empty and we defaulted. That contributed to silent alignment.

ops-ryan: Patch pushed to canary: add explicit 400 + telemetry. Will monitor.

support-bot: INC-4921 updated: canary patch deployed.

ben_support: I'll follow up with customer once canary is green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
